cards.name: Day Camp
cards.description: Day camp for children who have completed kindergarten and meet the camp's age cutoff.
cards.review_notes: The undated Day Camp section states that children must have completed kindergarten and cannot turn 12 before January 1 of the camp year; the numeric maximum represents that cutoff, not an age limit throughout camp. It says camp ends in August but gives no exact dates. The 2026 flyer attachment could not be read. Camp drop-off location is not identified: the department page lists an office at 30 Rec Park Drive and a contact address at 240 West Deep Creek Road, while also reporting the indoor facility closed. Confirm the camp venue before mapping.
